To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the activities of 5α-reducing enzymes, which lead to the production of the cancer promoting 4-pregnen-5α-ols, are significantly elevated in tumorigenic breast cancer cells compared to nontumorigenec breast cancer cells.

the 5alpha-reductase (leading to the production of cancer promoting 5alpha-pregnanes) and the 3alpha(20alpha)-hydroxysteriod oxidoreductases (producing anti-cancer 3alpha(4)-pregnenes) are expressed and function differently in tumorigenic and nontumorgenic breast cancer cells.

(1) the 5α-reduction of progesterone is significantly higher in three tumorigenic breast cancer cell lines than in a nontumorogenic breast cancer cell line, and (2) the 20α-reduction of 4-pregnenolone and 3α-reduction of Δ4-3-ketopregnenolone are significantly higher in a nontumerogenic breast cancer cell lines that in three tumorigenetic breast cancer cell lines.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the progesterone metabolites that may play a role in breast cancer.
the identification and quantification of the progesterone metabolites produced by breast cancer cells, and the elucidation of the mechanisms responsible for these differences in metabolism.
understanding the mechanisms by which progesterone metabolite levels are increased in tumorous breast tissue.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the increased expression and activity of 5α-reduction of progesterone in tumorigenic breast cancer cells is associated with increased breast cancer risk.

the increased 5αR expression/activity and decreased 20α- and 3αHSO expression/activity in tumorigenic cells may lead to increased production of 5α-reduces progesterone metabolites, which may stimulate breast cancer.
the 5 α-reductase activity and expression of 5 α-reduced progesterone metabolites are higher in the three tumorigeneic cell lines than in nontumorigeneic cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 5AR:3AR ratio is higher in tumorigenic cells than in non-tumorigenic cells.
5αR expression is increased in tumorigenic cell types and 5αR activities are increased in all tumorigenic cells.
the nontumorous MCF-10 A cells produce 20α and 3α metabolites of progesterone and these metabolites may have anti-tumorigenic activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 5 α reductase enzyme is highly expressed in breast cancer cells and this enzyme is responsible for converting progesterone to 5 alpha pregnane, a potent breast cancer promoter.
the 5alpha-reductase enzyme, which produces the 5alpha-pregnanes, is expressed at higher levels in the breast cancer cell lines than in normal breast cells.
the 5alpha-reductase activity is higher in the tumour cells than in the non-tumour cells.
